tbesh_subentries.definition_html: (Qal) to love, be attached to, long for

tbesh_html: (Qal) to love, be attached to, long for

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to cling, i.e. join, (figuratively) to love, delight in; elliptically; to deliver
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; also interchangeable for H2820 (חָשַׂךְ)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: have a delight, (have a) desire, fillet, long, set (in) love.
